name: XWFlow Kpi
description: A headline number on a glowing tile. The number itself is an XWUIDisplayStatistic.

value.description: null when the value was not recorded; `emptyLabel` shows instead.

note.description: Small print under the value, such as "as of 12 s ago".

tone.description: Colour of the glow in the corner.

emphasis.description: Colour the number itself, for alarming values.
